summary: The implementation successfully addresses all three requirements: REQ-1 (debug admin route errors), REQ-2 (add error boundary), and REQ-3 (verify backend verifyAdmin method). The diff shows comprehensive changes including backend admin authentication methods, frontend AdminGuard improvements with detailed error handling and login dialog, ErrorBoundary component creation, and enhanced error logging throughout the admin authentication flow.

hallucinated_features.description: Added changeAdminPassword method in backend allowing admins to change the admin password
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly states as non-goals: 'Adding new admin features or functionality' and 'Changing the authentication mechanism'. The changeAdminPassword feature was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Added authenticate method in backend that grants admin role to authenticated users
hallucinated_features.reason: While authentication is part of the fix, the BuildRequest does not specify creating a new authenticate method that grants admin roles. This extends beyond verifying credentials to implementing a new authentication mechanism, which contradicts the non-goal of 'Changing the authentication mechanism'.
